data.summary: The reviews for 'Five Star Pools' show low volume for a long-established company. The few reviews present are a mix of vague praise and vague complaints, lacking the specific details, emotional authenticity, and volume typical of a thriving contractor. The Yelp listing is marked as closed. There is insufficient evidence to confirm a pattern of authentic customer experiences.
fake_signals: Vague, generic praise in positive reviews (e.g., 'Great team', 'Was Great !')
Low review volume (7 on Google, 8 on Yelp) for a 27-year-old company
One negative review is also vague and lacks specific details
authentic_signals: Some reviews mention specific contexts (HOA service, broken pump)
One review mentions a staff member by name (Sheryl)
Varied posting dates over several years
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are consistent across Google and Yelp. BBB has no rating. Glassdoor results appear to be for a different company (Suffolk) and are not relevant.
